before: A turned or flipped group had no graphic projection and painted a placeholder. A turned member in a group with uneven child scaling painted skewed.
after: A turned or flipped group paints every member flipped and turned about its extent centre and selects by its painted members. A turned member turns about its scaled box, paints whole past the group extent, and lays out its text in that box. A gradient with rotWithShape off moves with a turned group without turning. Source XML, including group rot and flips, is unchanged.
reason: Only the graphic projection changes, so hit testing and the selection frame follow it. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
